decisions.reason: The CC1 Q-and-Deadwax framing clarification does not change whether or when the separate opening aerial establishing shot is required.
The source specifies the atomic CC1 character-framing sequence but does not replace the designated script version or otherwise change the general shot-direction requirement.

The client clarifies that "set" referred to three image pairs and defines their framing progression; this does not alter the requirement that sets match the intended style and remain visually consistent between shots.
The number, character composition, and framing of the CC1 image pairs do not change the project-wide artistic-style consistency rule.
The source clarifies image-pair organization and shot distance, not the required quality of set images or permission to generate higher-quality replacements.
